skills.name: vreeman-stoic-library
skills.description: Look up, search or quote Marcus Aurelius' Meditations. Use when a task needs the exact wording of an entry (such as 4.3), passages on a theme such as anger or death, or a stable citation link to one. Covers all 499 entries of Books 1-12 in the Gregory Hays translation, published on vreeman.com as an MCP search tool, one JSON file holding the whole corpus, and a permanent anchor per entry. Also the way in to the rest of that site's Stoic library of Epictetus, Seneca and Stockdale.
